description.value: A randomized fMRI study comparing clozapine and risperidone effects on cannabis cue reactivity and subjective craving in male patients with schizophrenia and cannabis use disorder.

spans.text: The current study is the first randomized controlled trial investigating differences between clozapine and risperidone treatment in regional brain responses associated with cue reactivity and subjective craving for cannabis in patients with schizophrenia.

value: we hypothesized that subjective craving would be associated with regional brain activation following cannabis-related images

description.value: An open-label randomized controlled trial with baseline and four-week follow-up assessments; healthy controls were assessed once.

spans.text: We conducted an open-label randomized controlled trial investigating the difference between clozapine and risperidone on subjective cannabis craving and brain activity following visual cannabis-related and non-cannabis related cues during fMRI scanning.
Patients were randomly allocated to receive either clozapine or risperidone.
